# 37 vs 37). Catalog default effort is medium (not low), so no pin. They
# supersede gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-luna, which stay routable as legacy (Codex:
# "remain available during GPT-6 rollout"). No GPT-6 Terra exists; bulk stays on
# gpt-5.6-terra until an independent per-task cost comparison says otherwise.
# gpt-5.5 leaves Codex for ChatGPT sign-in (= this machine's seat auth) on
# 2026-10-14 (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models); catalog-drift should then flag it vanished.
# grok: 4.7 is the default grok (task recency -> grok-4.7-high); note its ids
# have NO "cursor-" prefix in the Cursor catalog, unlike 4.6/4.5. The 4.6 and
# 4.5 rows stay routable as legacy while the Cursor catalog still lists them.
# bin/catalog-drift.sh (routecheck + SessionStart hook) warns when a newer
# cursor-grok-* / composer-* / glm-* / gpt-* version appears in a catalog.
# xai = the DIRECT xAI Responses API (curl, XAI_API_KEY from env/~/.profile,
# store:false, tools web_search + x_search) — the only route with REAL X search
# (grok via cursor-agent has web search only). The id is ours, not an xAI one
# (xAI's is column 4), so it never collides with Cursor's grok-4.7-* ids.
# Wired 2026-09-22 for the model scout's X hot-takes pass (task x-recency).

# still surfaces as unrouted ([lmhx]* = low/medium/high/xhigh/max, so
# claude-opus-5-[lmhx]* does not swallow a future claude-opus-5-6-*).
